suffix: Flat vector illustration style, bold simple shapes, thick clean outlines, limited palette of solid flat colors only, large clean areas of color, no fine detail, no thin hairlines. Front view, perfectly symmetrical where possible, centered on a plain pure white background, square 1:1, generous white margin, nothing outside the badge. Leave every text band and ribbon completely EMPTY with no letters, no numbers, no words. No distressed texture, no grain, no halftone, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no mockup, no watermark, no real brand.
